Native calibration generation time includes profiler overhead; it is not a warmed unprofiled native baseline.
FA2 signatures alias self- and cross-attention input lengths with up to 21.7x sampled duration variation. 98.88% prediction coverage does not establish timing accuracy.
CPU calibration has 264 unresolved samples out of 3065 total instruction samples (8.61%), on the GX host rather than the A100 host.
Only camera-memory selection has three distinct PCV states; other marked interfaces are underdetermined.
